plan.title: leftover(#7272): harness-attended human-presence mint for approved-scope and authz

narratives.Description: leftover(#7272): harness-attended human-presence mint for approved-scope and authz
narratives.Overview: Keep #7031 declared writers for obs/intent and #6945 signed keep-out. For approved-scope and inventoried authz mutators only, let the harness request mint and open an operator-controlled confirmation surface; bare chat-yes never stamps. Confirmation is controlling-TTY phrase or a host-authenticated user-event bound to a frozen single-use request; markers stay set (no forge-by-unset). Write only that unchanged request through existing writers after a fresh admission recheck. Cite Prefer-A Bound comment 7139661247.
narratives.Labels: agent-experience, process, harness, design-critique:ingest-ready, framework-gap, promise:gates
narratives.UserStory: As an operator in an attended harness, I need approved-scope and authz human-presence mints to complete via an operator-controlled confirm bound to the frozen request and checkout, without unsetting agent-shell markers or treating bare chat-yes as the stamp.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Prefer-A Bound 7139661247 limbs; human-presence-mint + approved-scope/authz writers; human-origin-authz inventory; tests; changelog.d.

items.title: relieves: P1 — Route only scope:record-approved-scope and inventoried authz kept-mint mutators from the harness into an operator-controlled confirmation surface (controlling-TTY phrase or host-authenticated user-event) that lands the stamp while agent-shell markers stay set and without forge-by-unset.
relieves: P1 — Treat bare chat-yes as request-open only so it never authorizes the write itself and never substitutes for that confirmation surface.

relieves: P2 — Freeze verb, authority payload, canonical checkout, and resolved destination set under a single-use request id before confirmation, and refuse changed, cancelled, expired, or already-completed requests.
relieves: P2 — Complete only through existing writers after a fresh command-specific admission recheck at confirm time, including active-UAT restrictions and the suspend exception.

relieves: P3 — Keep obs/intent on #7031 declared writers plus merge control, refuse restoring --minted-via in-harness-ask for those verbs, keep #6945 signed-approval keep-out, and preserve ordinary human CLI mint outside the harness path.
